content.short: StakeWise lets users stake ETH and earn rewards through a beginner-friendly application.
content.description: StakeWise is a simplified, open-source Ethereum staking app launched in March 2021. The platform lets DeFi users stake any amount of ETH to help secure the network and earn staking rewards. Staking ETH through StakeWise yields sETH2, usable with other Ethereum-based dApps. Developers can leverage the StakeWise API and smart contracts to integrate ETH staking into their own apps. Since launch, StakeWise has accumulated over 50,000 ETH in deposits.
